title: Preparation reaches startup
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose the forward and find-mode settings, and let $R,T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that on every input word $x$, the fuel machine halts within $T(|x|)$ steps, outputs the binary digit word of $R(|x|)$, and uses some amount of space. Then for every Boolean input $x$, there are a fuel configuration $c$ and a time $t$ such that $c$ is halted, its output is the binary digit word of $R(|x|)$, $t\le 5T(|x|)+7$, and the loop host run for $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$ equals the prepared startup configuration built from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite machines B and F
functions R and T from natural numbers to natural numbers
F computes the binary digit word of R(input length) in time T(input length)
replaced:

binary digit word of $R(|x|)$. Then for every input $x$ there are a halted fuel
configuration $c$ with output exactly that digit word and a time $t \le 5\,T(|x|) + 7$
such that the loop host, run for $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$,
